comparison.objective: Hang a door by aligning its knuckles and inserting a pin through all five.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual support of an unsupported door, multi-hole alignment, and long-pin insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Door knuckles aligned and hinge pin passed through all five; numeric tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Although both require coaxial alignment, this tests load-bearing multi-hole insertion rather than impact fracture and containment.
